# Oligomenorrhea(Archived)

**Authors:** Yumna Riaz, Utsav Parekh

**Source:** StatPearls - StatPearls Publishing

## Abstract

Oligomenorrhea is defined as irregular and infrequent menstrual cycles in women. Some variation in menstrual flow is normal during menarche, postpartum, or the perimenopausal period. However, if a woman reports menstrual cycles longer than 35 days or fewer than 4 to 9 cycles per year, it is considered oligomenorrhea. Normal menstrual flow should precede the development of oligomenorrhea.
